messages:
elena: pushing up the new structured-output eval runner for the tool-calling tests. can folks smoke it in CI?

sam: on it. quick context: this harness validates function call correctness and JSON schema conformance across model variants (fp16, int8 qn). trying to catch regressions when we swap quantization profiles.

pranav: saw a failing job just now in canary. CI shows schema mismatch even though the model locally returns valid JSON.

ci-bot: [build #4821] test_struct_output — failed (exit 1)
ci-bot: stdout:
```
ERROR: schema validation failed at example 12: expected property 'tool_name' to be string, got null
Model output:
{"type":"toolCall","name":null,"arguments":"{\"file\":\"/tmp/log.txt\"}"}
```

lauren: hmm that output looks like our old runtime 'toolCall' wrapper, not the standardized function_call object we validate against. did we accidentally route canary traffic to an older runtime image? :thinking_face:

elena: possible. CI runner spins up a docker image based on inference:canary.172. I updated the runner yesterday to attach a postprocess that converts toolCall->function_call to support legacy models, but maybe the conversion is buggy when args are a string vs object.

sam: pasting the schema we're using for validation:
```
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["name", "arguments"],
  "properties": {
    "name": {"type": "string"},
    "arguments": {"type": "object"}
  }
}
```

pranav: the log shows arguments is a string (JSON-encoded). Our schema expects an object. The postprocess should parse it into an object. looks like parse failed and left name null in that run.

elena: I can repro locally by forcing the runner to return the raw string payload. here's the failing snippet in the postprocess function:
```
if (out.type === 'toolCall') {
  return {function_call: {name: out.name || null, arguments: JSON.parse(out.arguments)}}
}
```
When out.arguments is already an object, JSON.parse throws. I forgot to guard for typeof.

lauren: ok that explains the null. JSON.parse on object -> throws, caught by higher layer and returns partial object with name null? we should fix to: if (typeof out.arguments === 'string') try parse else use as-is.

sam: will open a hotfix PR for the runner. also, two follow-ups: 1) CI should run schema validation both lenient and strict modes to catch this. 2) add a small fuzz test that emits arguments as string/object/escaped-json to avoid regressions.

elena: +1. another wrinkle: int8 quant runs sometimes change tokenization around punctuation which means the assistant sometimes emits "arguments": "{\"file\": \"/tmp/log.txt\"}" vs object. we should include quant profile variations in the CI matrix.

pranav: I noticed flakiness where metric 'exact_function_name_match' dips by ~0.03 on some int8 profiles — could be the wrapper mismatch hiding correct names. until we fix the runner, metrics are noisy.

lauren: for reporting dashboard: mark those recent runs as 'suspect' and annotate with 'runner postprocess bug'. ops-bot can you tag the latest artifacts?

ops-bot: tagged runs: #4821, #4819 with label 'suspect-postprocess' :white_check_mark:

sam: quick plan: 1) PR to guard JSON.parse + unit tests (5 tests). 2) extend CI matrix to include fp16/int8/quantized-ptq. 3) add a lightweight fuzz target emitting string/object/escaped JSON for arguments. 4) re-run the failing build and promote good artifact.

elena: i'll own verification and dashboard annotation. if someone can review the PR fast (small change), we can unblock the onboarding of the new model bundle which depends on structured output passing.

pranav: reviewing now. also adding a metric definition note: exact_function_name_match should ignore case and whitespace, and score only when schema passes. doc PR incoming.

sam: nerfing strictness in the dashboard now would hide real failures — prefer fixing runner + then re-computing historical metrics for last 48h.

lauren: agreed. thanks all. once PR merged, I'll trigger a full eval matrix run and update the dashboard. :rocket:

elena: PR merged and deployed to CI image tag inference:canary.173

ci-bot: [build #4825] test_struct_output — started

ci-bot: [build #4825] test_struct_output — passed

pranav: confirmed metrics stable on the re-run. exact_function_name_match back to baseline. closing the incident. :tada:
